description: This file contains utility functions for sanitizing, extracting, and rewriting tool call IDs within agent messages, specifically for handling tool call identifiers in a chat or agent system.

methods.name: sanitizeToolCallId
methods.description: Sanitizes a tool call ID to be compatible with various providers, supporting 'strict' and 'strict9' modes.

methods.name: extractToolCallsFromAssistant
methods.description: Extracts tool call-like objects from assistant messages.

methods.name: extractToolResultId
methods.description: Retrieves the tool result ID from a tool result message.

methods.name: isValidCloudCodeAssistToolId
methods.description: Validates a tool ID based on the mode ('strict' or 'strict9') for cloud code assist.

methods.name: shortHash
methods.description: Generates a short SHA-256 hash of a given text.

methods.name: makeUniqueToolId
methods.description: Creates a unique tool ID, considering used IDs and mode.

methods.name: createOccurrenceAwareResolver
methods.description: Creates resolver functions to handle ID conflicts and occurrences for assistant and tool result IDs.

methods.name: rewriteAssistantToolCallIds
methods.description: Rewrites IDs in assistant messages using a provided resolution function.

methods.name: rewriteToolResultIds
methods.description: Rewrites IDs in tool result messages using a provided resolution function.

methods.name: sanitizeToolCallIdsForCloudCodeAssist
methods.description: Sanitizes IDs in a list of agent messages for cloud code assist, ensuring provider compatibility and handling ID collisions.
